streaming.liveText: # NoteStore Implementation Specification## Project ContextBased on codebase exploration:- Project root: Contains package.json (ES modules), tsconfig.json (strict TypeScript, ES2022 target)- src directory: Currently empty, ready for new module implementation- Runtime: Bun with bun:test framework available- No existing patterns: This is a greenfield module within the project## Technical Requirements### File: src/note-store.ts#### Note InterfaceExport an interface Note with the following properties:- id: string - Unique identifier (UUID v4 format)- title: string - Note title (trimmed, non-empty)- done: boolean - Completion status, defaults to false- created_at: number - Unix timestamp in milliseconds (Date.now())#### NoteStore ClassExport a class NoteStore with the following characteristics:- Backing store: Private Map<string, Note> for in-memory storage- Constructor: Initialize empty Map#### Methods1. create(title: string): Note   - Trim the input title using String.prototype.trim()   - Throw an error if the trimmed title is empty (length === 0)   - Generate UUID using crypto.randomUUID()   - Set done to false   - Set created_at to Date.now()   - Store the note in the Map keyed by id   - Return the created Note object2. get(id: string): Note | undefined   - Retrieve note from Map by id   - Return the Note if found, undefined otherwise3. list(): Note[]   - Return all notes as an array   - Sort by created_at in ascending order (oldest first)   - Return a new array (not the internal Map values directly)4. toggle(id: string): Note | undefined   - Find the note by id   - If not found, return undefined   - If found, flip the done boolean value   - Return the updated Note object (same reference, mutated in place)5. remove(id: string): boolean   - Delete the note from the Map by id   - Return true if the note existed and was deleted   - Return false if the note did not exist### File: src/note-store.test.ts#### Test Framework- Import from bun:test: test, describe, expect- Import Note and NoteStore from ./note-store#### Required Test Cases1. create returns a complete Note   - Create a new NoteStore instance   - Call create("Test Note")   - Assert the returned object has all required properties   - Assert id is a valid UUID string (36 characters with hyphens)   - Assert title equals the input (trimmed)   - Assert done is false   - Assert created_at is a number (timestamp)2. empty title throws   - Create a new NoteStore instance   - Call create("") or create("   ") (whitespace only)   - Assert that an error is thrown using expect(() => ...).toThrow()3. list preserves creation order   - Create a new NoteStore instance   - Create multiple notes with small delays or verify by created_at   - Call list()   - Assert notes are sorted by created_at ascending   - Verify the order matches creation sequence4. toggle flips done   - Create a new NoteStore instance   - Create a note   - Call toggle(note.id)   - Assert the returned note has done === true   - Call toggle(note.id) again   - Assert the returned note has done === false   - Test toggling non-existent id returns undefined5. remove deletes successfully   - Create a new NoteStore instance   - Create a note   - Call remove(note.id)   - Assert it returns true   - Call get(note.id)   - Assert it returns undefined   - Test removing non-existent id returns false## Code Quality RequirementsPer project preferences:- code_comments: Add clear comments explaining the class purpose, method behavior, and any non-obvious logic- code_design_principle: Keep the NoteStore self-contained with no external dependencies beyond crypto- High cohesion: All note-related logic stays within the NoteStore class## Implementation Notes- Use crypto.randomUUID() which is available in Bun/Node.js environments- The Map provides O(1) lookup for get, toggle, and remove operations- list() requires O(n log n) sorting but is acceptable for in-memory storage- No persistence layer required - pure in-memory implementation- No event emission or observer patterns required for this minimal implementation## Testing Strategy- Each test case should be independent (create fresh NoteStore instance per test or per describe block)- Use describe blocks to group related tests- Use descriptive test names following bun:test best practices- All 5 required test cases must pass for acceptance
